Name: A.I.R. Play
Overview:
In the future, football is played by advanced robots using a plasma football that gradually get hooter over the course of a game and will eventually explode. The aim of the game, to score as many goals as possible is unchanged, but instead of there being eleven players on the pitch, there are only four, two on each team, one goalkeeper and one outfield player. It is up to the player to guide one of these futuristic teams to the 'AirPlay Tournament' using the players choice of 14 robotic players.

For multiplayer games, there is support for local 2 player head to head games on a single Xbox 360 with a choice of seven arenas to choose from.
